title: Get consent to trade from a stall or display goods on a road
what: Get the council's consent before setting up a stall, stand or standing vehicle, or displaying goods, on a road or footpath for a commercial or promotional purpose.

laws.title: Public Land and Council Assets Local Law 2014

sources.title: Public Land and Council Assets Local Law 2014
sources.quote: Any activity specified in Table 1 of Schedule 2 (a regulated activity) requires council consent.

sources.title: Public Land and Council Assets Local Law 2014
sources.quote: Setting up or using in or on any road any stall, booth, stand, tables or chairs or both or standing vehicle for a purpose of or connected with the carrying on of any commercial or promotional activity

sources.title: Public Land and Council Assets Local Law 2014
sources.quote: Displaying, stacking or storing articles or vehicles on a road or colonnade
